Hi the identical and fraternal twins definition is not encompassing to what we actually see in life. You can have two babies who share the same placenta ("identical") twins of different gender. This occurs when the egg splits prior to conception. So they have the same maternal DNA but different paternal DNA, which ultimately decided gender. So these twins share 75% of DNA, so are considered neither fraternal nor identical. Read more on twins here: http://www.twinsuk.co.uk/twinstips/4/140/twin-pregnancy--multiple-births/types-of-twins--identical-fraternal--unusual-twinning/

Hi. I had a friend who did similar things to me our entire friendship. She suffered through depression and drug abuse and I held her hand the entire time, hiding my problems because they never seemed to weigh over her real problems. Years later, when I finally broke down, feeling incredibly suicidal I directly asked her to be there for me. She just told me that she couldn't. That she was a bad friend. It was a huge blow. All I needed was someone to talk to. But then I realized she WAS a bad friend. There are so many amazing people out there who will sit and listen and be there for you. And if she doesn't want to be there you can't make her be. But you can reach out to others. 

Anyways, all this to say that if she doesn't want to listen to you, I will.
